source.title: Legal software taxonomy v1 (US law firms)
source.notes: Seeded from KEYS.md for the PAT legal channel. 24 FUNCTION buckets, 8 WORKFLOW_STAGE buckets, 4 COMPLIANCE_DOMAIN buckets, 4 DELIVERY_MODEL buckets. Descriptions summarize capabilities described on vendor-published product and pricing pages recorded in the six research notes retrieved 2026-09-29. vendors, products and vendorSignals are empty on purpose, matching the accounting substrate, until the vendor catalog writer's grounded entries are loaded. legal-load (R64, 2026-10-11): seven keys shared with the accounting artifact (delivery-cloud, delivery-hybrid, delivery-managed, function-document-management, function-payments, workflow-deliver, workflow-review) carry a -legal suffix, because TaxonomyBucket.key is unique across verticals and the importer upserts by key; without the suffix a legal import would restamp accounting's rows.

patProductUtilityRegistry.notes: 20 utility families, 80 subcategories, 400 questions. Each family maps to one or more FUNCTION buckets plus workflow stages and, where relevant, a COMPLIANCE_DOMAIN bucket. function-esignature has no family of its own; it is carried as a subcategory of document_automation_assembly.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Practice and Matter Management
taxonomyBuckets.description: Matter records, contacts, tasks, calendars, notes and the case workflow that ties time, documents and billing to a matter.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Time and Billing
taxonomyBuckets.description: Time capture, rate tables, prebills, invoice generation, e-billing submission and collections follow-up.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Trust Accounting (IOLTA)
taxonomyBuckets.description: Client trust ledgers, trust receipts and disbursements, trust-to-operating transfers and three-way reconciliation of bank, book and client ledger balances.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Payments
taxonomyBuckets.description: Card, ACH and eCheck acceptance for legal invoices and retainers, payment plans, surcharging and posting of payments to operating and trust accounts.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Client Intake and CRM
taxonomyBuckets.description: Lead capture, intake forms and questionnaires, pipeline tracking, engagement letters and marketing automation ahead of matter opening.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Secure Client Portals and Communication
taxonomyBuckets.description: Client-facing portals for document sharing, secure messaging, invoice viewing, payment and case status updates.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Document Management
taxonomyBuckets.description: Matter-centric storage of documents and email with versioning, profiling, search, check-out and access control.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Document Automation and Assembly
taxonomyBuckets.description: Template-driven generation of legal documents and court forms from matter data, questionnaires and clause libraries.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Knowledge Management and Enterprise Search
taxonomyBuckets.description: Search and curation of precedents, prior work product and firm expertise across the DMS, email and other repositories.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Contract Lifecycle Management
taxonomyBuckets.description: Contract request, drafting, negotiation, approval, execution, repository storage, data extraction and obligation tracking.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Legal Research
taxonomyBuckets.description: Primary law, secondary sources and citator services with search, alerts and AI-assisted research features.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Legal Analytics
taxonomyBuckets.description: Docket-derived analytics on judges, courts, parties, counsel, motion outcomes and timing.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Generative AI Legal Assistants
taxonomyBuckets.description: Large language model assistants for drafting, summarization, document review and question answering grounded in legal content and firm documents.

taxonomyBuckets.title: E-Discovery and Review
taxonomyBuckets.description: Processing, early case assessment, search, technology-assisted review, redaction and production of electronically stored information.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Litigation Support and Case Analysis
taxonomyBuckets.description: Fact chronologies, transcript and deposition management, exhibit organization and trial presentation.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Legal Hold
taxonomyBuckets.description: Hold notice issuance, custodian acknowledgement tracking, preservation-in-place connectors and release workflows.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Court E-Filing and Docketing
taxonomyBuckets.description: Electronic filing and service through court-approved providers, docket retrieval and docket entry into firm systems.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Rules-Based Calendaring and Deadlines
taxonomyBuckets.description: Court-rules-driven deadline calculation, calendar sync and change tracking for litigation dates.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Conflicts Checking and Ethical Walls
taxonomyBuckets.description: Searching parties and related entities against firm records at intake and enforcing confidentiality screens across firm systems.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Records and Information Governance
taxonomyBuckets.description: Retention schedules, disposition, physical and electronic records tracking and file return at matter close.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Legal Project Management and Pricing
taxonomyBuckets.description: Matter budgets, phase and task plans, alternative fee modeling and budget-to-actual tracking.

taxonomyBuckets.title: E-Signature
taxonomyBuckets.description: Electronic signature capture on engagement letters, settlement documents and client forms with audit trail.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Integration Platforms
taxonomyBuckets.description: APIs, app directories, iPaaS connectors and sync tooling that move data between legal and general business systems.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Identity and Security
taxonomyBuckets.description: Single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, directory integration, encryption, audit logging and security certifications for legal software.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Intake
taxonomyBuckets.description: Lead capture, conflict screening and matter opening.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Engage
taxonomyBuckets.description: Engagement terms, budgets and client onboarding to portals and payment channels.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Work
taxonomyBuckets.description: Legal work product: research, drafting, review, filings and case analysis.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Review
taxonomyBuckets.description: Quality review, approvals and supervisory checks on work product and contracts.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Deliver
taxonomyBuckets.description: Delivery to clients and courts: filing, service, signature and client communication.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Bill
taxonomyBuckets.description: Time capture, invoicing, trust handling, payments and collections.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Close
taxonomyBuckets.description: Matter closing, final trust disbursement and closing letters.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Retain
taxonomyBuckets.description: Records retention, legal hold, disposition and file return.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Trust Accounting Compliance
taxonomyBuckets.description: Handling of client funds under state trust account rules, including reconciliation and record keeping.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Confidentiality and Data Security
taxonomyBuckets.description: Protection of client confidential and privileged information, access controls and ethical screens.

taxonomyBuckets.title: E-Discovery and Preservation
taxonomyBuckets.description: Preservation, collection and production duties for electronically stored information.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Records Retention and File Return
taxonomyBuckets.description: Retention of client files and records and their return or disposition after representation ends.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Cloud
taxonomyBuckets.description: Vendor-hosted multi-tenant or single-tenant software delivered as a service.

taxonomyBuckets.title: On-premise
taxonomyBuckets.description: Software installed and operated on firm-controlled servers.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Hybrid
taxonomyBuckets.description: Desktop or on-premise components paired with a vendor cloud back end.

taxonomyBuckets.title: Managed
taxonomyBuckets.description: Software operated for the firm by a service provider or hosting partner.
